summary.text: Matt Hostettler is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 64, which he has represented since November 2018, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Candace Greer as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Matt Hostettler was born and raised in southwest Indiana and graduated from North Posey High School.
He earned a bachelor of science in management from Purdue University and worked as a crude oil gauger and pipeline operator for CountryMark Refining and Logistics.
Hostettler took office on November 7, 2018, succeeding Thomas Washburne.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the House Natural Resources and Public Health committees and as vice chair of the Employment, Labor and Pensions Committee.
